prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 1】假设你正在撰写【时间序列论文 Methodology 章节或开题报告】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想专门阐述时间序列模型中“如何在频域捕获全局周期性，同时在时域保留局部突发异常（Transient Anomalies）”的双分支耦合机制。”。请严格按照 `BP14` 的逐句功能骨架（4 步法）与逻辑法则 `L014`（公式与散文无缝咬合：先给直觉动机，后推符号定义（Intuition-Before-Math）），写出一段 4–5 句、零 AI 痕迹、主语紧凑（≤6词）的自然英文段落。
source_material_or_draft: We use both FFT and CNN in our model. FFT gets global features and CNN gets local features. Then we add them together to get final features.
structural_constraints: S1 [单域局限性 Single-Domain Limitation]：Modeling non-stationary time series solely in the time domain struggles to capture long-range periodicities, whereas pure Fourier projection blurs localized transient anomalies.

S2 [频域分支设计 Frequency Branch]：To capture global seasonal structure, our spectral branch applies real-valued FFT $\mathcal{F}(\cdot)$ along the temporal dimension and reweights dominant harmonic components.
S3 [时域分支设计 Temporal Branch]：In parallel, a multi-scale depthwise convolution branch operates directly on local patches to preserve sharp step changes and localized spikes.
S4 [自适应门控融合 Adaptive Fusion]：An uncertainty-aware gate then fuses both branches step-by-step, assigning higher weight to the temporal branch whenever local residual variance exceeds a threshold.

消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）

prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：IELTS_Task1_Static 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT14 (雅思小作文（Task 1）静态柱状图与饼图组合满分范文：云端推理与机载机器人控制系统的能耗结构对比)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP25 -> BP27 -> BP28`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: We use both FFT and CNN in our model. FFT gets global features and CNN gets local features. Then we add them together to get final features.
structural_constraints: S1 [单域局限性 Single-Domain Limitation]：Modeling non-stationary time series solely in the time domain struggles to capture long-range periodicities, whereas pure Fourier projection blurs localized transient anomalies.

S2 [频域分支设计 Frequency Branch]：To capture global seasonal structure, our spectral branch applies real-valued FFT $\mathcal{F}(\cdot)$ along the temporal dimension and reweights dominant harmonic components.
S3 [时域分支设计 Temporal Branch]：In parallel, a multi-scale depthwise convolution branch operates directly on local patches to preserve sharp step changes and localized spikes.
S4 [自适应门控融合 Adaptive Fusion]：An uncertainty-aware gate then fuses both branches step-by-step, assigning higher weight to the temporal branch whenever local residual variance exceeds a threshold.
target_defects_to_fix: 过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 深化论证段，或论文 Motivation 强化段
domain_context: 六级/雅思大作文：AI 自动化、教育与科研伦理
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想在议论文或科研立项书中，通过严密的“反事实推演（If we fail to... / Absent X...）”强化紧迫感与说服力。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP39` 与全文样板 `FT14` 的后半部分（``），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: In this paper, we propose a novel and groundbreaking model called DyTS-Net. It has three modules: Module A, Module B, and Module C. They work together to delve into the data and get state-of-the-art performance.
structural_constraints: S1 [正面基准命题 Positive Baseline]：Maintaining rigorous [Principle/Standard X] serves as the primary safeguard against [Systemic Risk Y].
S2 [反事实假设切入 Counterfactual Premise]：Absent this safeguard—if [Actors] were to rely exclusively on [Unchecked Alternative]—[Immediate Vulnerability] would quickly emerge.
S3 [连锁恶化传导 Cascading Deterioration]：Once [Immediate Vulnerability] takes hold, [Secondary Consequence] compounds across cycles, eventually eroding [Core Foundation].
S4 [实证印证或结论锁定 Empirical Echo]：This degradation dynamic mirrors [Real-world/Technical Precedent], underscoring why [Principle X] cannot be compromised for short-term convenience.
target_defects_to_fix: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例
